features.statement: Page uses system-ui sans-serif font stack instead of a custom webfont.
Body text is relatively large (about 17px) with generous line height around 1.65.
Headlines and section titles are heavy bold (700), large, with normal or tight letter spacing rather than wide tracking.
Small uppercase letter-spaced muted labels are used for section headings and eyebrow-style titles.
Dark navy page theme with near-white text.
Single bright teal/mint accent color used for buttons, links and highlights.
Text uses two tones: white headings and muted blue-grey body copy on dark cards.
Dark section backgrounds alternate between lighter and darker navy, with cards on a lighter navy surface.
A light-colored band interrupts the dark page to hold a logo strip.
Hero has no photograph, only dark background with soft radial color glows and gradients.
Page omits illustrative images and uses text-only cards, leaving only logos and badges.
Alt text is plain, human-readable brand names, with none missing.
Primary call-to-action is a fully rounded pill button in accent color with title-case text.
Header is sticky-style translucent with backdrop blur, and nav links are right-aligned with uniform plain styling.
Secondary links are uppercase accent-colored text links with a trailing arrow instead of outlined buttons.
Content is presented in rounded bordered cards stacked full-width with tight gaps.
Video block is a rounded gradient panel with a large accent-colored play button.
Footer is dark with multi-column grid of uppercase headings and plain text links, plus a divider above a bottom bar.
Layout relies heavily on CSS grid and a narrower centered content container.
Long answer paragraphs span the full card width, producing long line lengths.
Page is compact with tighter vertical spacing and no empty image slots.
Corners are more rounded, with larger radii and pill shapes, and no box shadows or animations.
Markup uses semantic section and article elements and a proper h1 holding the hero headline.
Heading hierarchy is clean, with section titles as h2 and footer column titles as h4.
Document is lean and static, with minimal classes, scripts, metadata and no structured-data blocks.
Page title is short, brand-only, and uses an em dash separator.
Copy uses em dashes and straight apostrophes for punctuation.
Contact details appear as plain visible text rather than a form.
